limits: The common-unit list is a fixed analysis choice, not a source of letter values.
The normalized labels do not keep every original case distinction.
Three permutation positions have no manuscript unit and remain unused.
An unknown unit gives every window that contains it a constant cost.
The score is a composite cost, not a sequence probability or language confidence.
The finite search does not prove a global optimum.
The source stream crosses word, locus, folio, and group boundaries.
Coverage shows assignment availability, not reading accuracy.
The two shuffles do not give a false-positive estimate or significance test.
A passing gate does not supply a complete key, language, grammar, meanings, or translation.
method.unknown_unit_policy: Keep every unit that is not in the common list unknown; assign no unused permutation value.

reason: The observed ZL test mean exceeds the fixed Latin baseline.

reference.limit: Exact normalized duplicate sentences are removed across partitions. Near duplicates remain. Dante partitions are canticles of one work by one author.
reference.normalization: NFKD casefold; remove combining marks; accept whole ASCII a-z forms only; preserve MWT surface forms; exclude empty nodes.

independence_limits: Expected scores use a separate literal count and position-order implementation.
Pinned corpus, grouping, and reference loaders are shared dependencies.
The audit does not infer a translation or validate a language claim.
independent_audit.write_order_evidence: Frozen runner source and the pre-freeze E2E checks; the independent audit compares final saved files.

isolated_replay.source_limit: Separate copies of the same manifest-pinned source bytes; no independent transcription.

saved_score_drift_readback.scope: Read back saved incremental and recomputed scores; not an independent score calculation.
